hook.say: Five countries completely surrounded by sea. Can you name each island nation from its outline alone?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Australia: its mainland is the smallest continent in the world.
questions.sayAnswer: Australia! Its mainland is the smallest continent in the world.

questions.fact: Madagascar is the fourth-largest island in the world.
questions.sayAnswer: Madagascar! It is the fourth largest island in the world.

questions.fact: New Zealand: Cook Strait splits its North and South Islands.
questions.sayAnswer: New Zealand! The Cook Strait splits its North and South Islands.

questions.fact: Iceland: Reykjavík is the northernmost capital of any sovereign state.
questions.sayAnswer: Iceland! Its capital, Reykjavik, is the northernmost capital of any sovereign state.

questions.fact: Cuba is the largest island in the Caribbean.
questions.sayAnswer: Cuba! It is the largest island in the Caribbean.
